description: Ireland: Capital Acquisitions Tax (CAT) on a gift or inheritance: group threshold by relationship, 33% above the unused threshold after earlier benefits in the same group since 5 December 1991…

date.description: Date of the gift or inheritance YYYY-MM-DD (decides the threshold)

group.description: Group by relationship to the person giving: A = child, B = parent/brother/sister/niece/nephew/grandparent/grandchild, C = anyone else

priorInGroup.description: Taxable value of earlier gifts/inheritances received in the same group since 5 December 1991, EUR (default 0)

value.description: Market value received, less debts and costs paid by you, EUR

name: ireland_inheritance_gift_tax
